entries.en: to post the guard; to stand guard under arms
to fly into a great rage; to become agitated
entries.notes: H「惑雜」与L「大怒」仅部分相合，M pàg-chap 义近纷杂。

entries.zh: 侵占他人产业；越界侵入
entries.en: to encroach on another's estate; to trespass

entries.zh: 缩身钻入（桌下）藏避；蜷伏自适
entries.en: to tuck oneself underneath (the table); to nestle out of sight
entries.notes: L栏漫漶（pⁿ、gien 未详），依H「攝自在」推定。

entries.en: to slip into the sleeve; to pocket in the sleeve
entries.notes: H「帶」疑为「袋」（袖袋），M tòà 可通。

entries.zh: 藏入袖中带走；袖藏而去
entries.en: to conceal in one's sleeve and make away; to sleeve
entries.notes: L「Canaga」词形可疑（疑为 manga 系误刻），依H「袖去」释义。

entries.zh: 参与其事；对交易插言置喙
entries.en: to put in one's say in a deal; to have a hand in the matter
entries.notes: H首字有「合/凹」两疑，M cap 支持「合」。

entries.en: to become a friar or monk; to enter religious life

entries.notes: L「narized o papel」漫漶，H首字「鉸」疑为「摳」，M 指向 khau-phīⁿ-khang。
H有「胲/胠」之疑，M cué 与「胲」相合。
H首字有「胲/胠」之疑，「胲腮頭」指腮颊部位。
H有「摻/漆」之疑，M chám 支持「摻」。
L「mezclar」与H「濕」不相应，M「humubo」不明，释义存疑。

entries.en: to mix; to blend; to join together
entries.notes: M栏夹西语「juntarse」，与L「mezclar」相合，H「洽」取调和义。

entries.zh: 混合之物（原稿字形「桼/糞」未定）
entries.en: mixed matter (character uncertain: lacquer or manure)
entries.notes: H「桼/糞」两可，M bùn 近「糞」，与L「混合物」不切。

entries.zh: 溶解；溶混（原稿「泳」疑为「溶」）
entries.en: to dissolve; to mix (character read 泳, probably 溶)
entries.notes: H「泳」与L「mezclada cosa」不相应，疑为「溶」之误摹，M ŏng 近 iông。
